label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code Settings Schema: Hooks configured in .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user). Hooks object with event names as keys (SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Notification, etc.), each containing array of hook configs with matcher and hooks array. Each hook: type (command, http, prompt, agent, mcp_tool), command (for command type), or other type-specific fields. Matcher filters which tool calls trigger hook (e.g., 'Edit|Write' for file edits). Multiple hooks per event run in parallel. PermissionRequest hooks for auto-mode denials.
